go = "1.26.1"

[env]
MODULE  = "github.com/nogo/wire"
BINARY  = "bin/wire"
VERSION = "{{ exec(command='git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo dev') }}"
COMMIT  = "{{ exec(command='git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown') }}"

[tasks.build]
description = "Build the binary"
sources    = ["**/*.go", "go.mod", "go.sum", "mise.toml"]
outputs    = ["bin/wire"]
run = """
DATE=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
LDFLAGS="-X $MODULE/internal.Version=$VERSION -X $MODULE/internal.Commit=$COMMIT -X $MODULE/internal.BuildDate=$DATE"
go build -ldflags "$LDFLAGS" -o "$BINARY" ./cmd/wire
"""

[tasks.clean]
description = "Remove build artifacts"
run = "rm -rf bin/"

[tasks.test]
description = "Run tests with race detector (no cache)"
run = "go test -race -count=1 ./..."

[tasks.vet]
description = "Run go vet"
sources = ["**/*.go", "go.mod"]
outputs = { auto = true }
run = "go vet ./..."

[tasks.fmt]
description = "Apply gofmt formatting"
run = "gofmt -w ."

[tasks."fmt:check"]
description = "Fail if any .go files are unformatted"
sources = ["**/*.go"]
outputs = { auto = true }
run = """
UNFORMATTED=$(gofmt -l .)
if [[ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]]; then
    echo "FAIL: unformatted files:"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
fi
"""

[tasks.tidy]
description = "Check go.mod and go.sum are tidy"
run = """
go mod tidy
if [[ -n "$(git diff --name-only go.mod go.sum 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
    echo "FAIL: go.mod/go.sum updated by tidy — commit the changes"
    exit 1
fi
"""

[tasks.lint]
description = "Run staticcheck (skipped if not installed)"
sources = ["**/*.go", "go.mod"]
outputs = { auto = true }
run = """
if command -v staticcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    staticcheck ./...
else
    echo "staticcheck not installed, skipping"
fi
"""

[tasks.check]
description = "Full local verification: vet, fmt, tidy, test, lint"
depends = ["vet", "fmt:check", "tidy", "test", "lint"]
run = 'echo "All checks passed."'

[tasks.verify]
description = "Run .forge/verify (authoritative project gate)"
run = ".forge/verify"

[tasks.install]
description = "Build and install wire binary + systemd service"
depends = ["build"]
run = """
install -Dm755 bin/wire "$HOME/.local/bin/wire"
install -Dm644 deploy/wire.service "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/wire.service"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
echo ""
echo "Installed wire to $HOME/.local/bin/wire"
echo "Installed systemd service to $HOME/.config/systemd/user/wire.service"
echo ""
echo "To enable wire on boot (without requiring a login session):"
echo "  loginctl enable-linger $USER"
echo "  systemctl --user enable wire"
echo ""
echo "To start now:"
echo "  systemctl --user start wire"
"""

[tasks.uninstall]
description = "Stop, disable, and remove wire binary + systemd service"
run = """
systemctl --user stop wire || true
systemctl --user disable wire || true
rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/wire"
rm -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/wire.service"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
"""

[tasks.dev]
description = "Rebuild on source changes (requires watchexec)"
run = "mise watch build"
